beats: When a kid's screen time ran out, the film just vanished, gone, like pulling the plug on movie night.
A parent's unlock used to mean relaunching everything, and the kid lost their place in the story.
Now the film pauses exactly where it was, and one QR code scan brings it right back.
It took building this twice in one evening — the first version's auto-resume simply didn't work.
Now it waits fifteen seconds in place before trying anything else.
